description: How long the watch of the uploaded files waits after a run of rounds with a failed read (docs/SPEC.md FR-3.2), in seconds: 2 after a round where every read answered, doubling after each round with a failure up to a minute, and null, giving up, after 8 such rounds in a row. A round that fails partway counts as one, whatever the reads before the failure answered. The map is read again on every return anyway.
